cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Basically Finished
cards.instruction: Describe incomplete, late, or improvised work as a thoughtful version of completion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Your cupboard's finished. I've left the shelves loose so you can choose the heights.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They fall down. You haven't fitted the supports.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. It's complete as an adjustable kit. Position everything around your tins.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I paid you to install it. Here's the drill.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll fasten one shelf at your chosen height. A finished sample, so you can approve the rest.

mechanism: A grants a completion label to unfinished installation and redefines B requests for actual work as approval of a limited sample.
confusable: A simple excuse delays completion; D41 must present the incomplete version as deliberately finished, with A ruling on what completion means.
comparison: A paid cupboard install is relabeled a kit and sample, unlike the report alternative replacing missing figures with a decision word.
seedUse: Use D41-a loose shelves and offered drill, with S01 approval controlling the advertised version of completion.
